name: NODDI Amico (single shell)
summary: Fits the NODDI model to single-shell DWI with the AMICO toolbox; only the orientation dispersion index (ODI) is reliable from single-shell data.
description: Same pipeline as the multi-shell NODDI AMICO App (FSL bet mask unless provided, b-value rounding, AMICO NODDI fit with the chosen parallel diffusivity) applied to single-shell DWI. Use it when only one diffusion shell is available and you need orientation dispersion; NDI and ISOVF from single-shell data should not be trusted.

inputs.description: this should be single shell dwi data
mask needs to be made from DWI image

outputs.description: only the orientation dispersion (OD) measure should be trusted
Brain mask in DWI space used for the fit (the provided mask, or one generated with FSL bet).

parameters.description: Parallel intrinsic diffusivity used by the NODDI model. Use 0.0017 for white matter and 0.0011 for cortical mapping.

Sometimes mask generation does not remove all of the non-brain material. If True, this will make sure the non-brain material is fully removed. Only check if inputting a mask that contains non-brain material
Select this if you want to perform signal debiasing before NODDI fit

citations.text: Daducci A, Canales-Rodriguez EJ, Zhang H, Dyrby TB, Alexander DC, Thiran JP. Accelerated Microstructure Imaging via Convex Optimization (AMICO) from diffusion MRI data. NeuroImage 105:32-44 (2015).
Zhang H, Schneider T, Wheeler-Kingshott CA, Alexander DC. NODDI: practical in vivo neurite orientation dispersion and density imaging of the human brain. NeuroImage 61(4):1000-1016 (2012).

failure_modes.cause: The NDI map was not produced by the AMICO fit.
failure_modes.fix: Check the log of NODDI.py; the multi-shell App needs multi-shell DWI.

failure_modes.cause: No brain mask was produced or provided.
failure_modes.fix: Provide a DWI-space brain mask or check the FSL bet step.
